LavRadioTower1FReceptionistText:
Welcome!
Feel free to look

around anywhere on
this floor.
LavRadioTower1FOfficerText:
Sorry, but you can
only tour the ground floor.

Ever since JOHTO's
RADIO TOWER was

taken over by a
criminal gang, we

have had to step
up our security.
LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd1Text:
Many people are
hard at work here

in the RADIO
TOWER.

They must be doing
their best to put on good shows.
LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText:
Oh, no, no, no!

We've been off the
air ever since the

POWER PLANT shut
down.

All my efforts to
start this station

would be wasted if
I can't broadcast.

I'll be ruined!
LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText_ReturnedMac:
Ah! So you're the
 who solved

the POWER PLANT's
problem?

Thanks to you, I
never lost my job.

I tell you, you're
a real lifesaver!

Please take this
as my thanks.
LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText_GotExpnCard:
With that thing,
you can tune into

the radio programs
here in KANTO.

Gahahahaha!
LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd2Text:
Hey there!

I am the super
MUSIC DIRECTOR!

Huh? Your #GEAR
can't tune into my

music programs.
How unfortunate!

If you get an EXPN
CARD upgrade, you

can tune in. You'd
better get one!
LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd2Text_GotExpnCar:
Hey there!

I am the super
MUSIC DIRECTOR!

I'm responsible
for the gorgeous

melodies that go
out over the air.

Don't be square.
Grab your music off the air!
